apply_rotation_transform: apply a Hadamard rotation transform to a PyTorch model using a RotationConfig or dict
HadamardRotation_from_config: build a HadamardRotation instance from a raw dict or RotationConfig object
HadamardRotation_apply_to_model: apply the Hadamard rotation to a model with weight or input location options
triton_available_check: check whether the Triton kernel path is available for the given data type
apply_weight_transform: fuse a Hadamard rotation transform into the weight of a single module
